senses.gloss: भ्रंश् vi. 1Ā, 4P (pp. भ्रष्ट; pres. भ्रंशते, भ्रश्यति; caus. भ्रंशयति-ते) 1. To fall, to drop down, नीवाराः शुकगर्भकोटरमुखभ्रष्टास्तरूणामधः Sak.i.; 2. to decline, to decrease; 3. to fall from, to be separated from, to be deprived of, (with an abl.), बंभ्रंशेऽसौ धृतेस्ततः Bt.xiv.71; 4. to escape, to flee from, (with an abl.), संग्रामाद्बभ्रशुः केचिद्ययाचुश्चापरेऽभयम् Bt.xiv.105, xv.59.With परि-, 1. to drop down, to tumble; 2. to go astray; 3. to fall away from; 4. to be deprived of.With प्र-, to drop down, प्रभ्रश्यमानाभरणप्रसूना R.xiv.54.With वि-, 1. to drop down; 2. to be free from; 3. to stray, to go astray.
भ्रंस् vi. 1Ā, 4P (pres. भ्रंसते, भ्रस्यति) The same as भ्रंश् q.v.

भ्रंश(स) m. 1. Falling off, dropping down, कनकवलयभ्रंशरिक्तप्रकोष्ठः Megh.i.2; 2. decay, overthrow, ruin; 3. decline, decrease; 4. disappearance; 5. loss, deprivation (as in जातिभ्रंश), स्मृतिभ्रंशाद्बुद्धिनाशः Bg.ii.63, सेहेऽस्य न भ्रंशमतो न लोभात् R.xvi.74; 6. Straying, deviation (as in शीलभ्रंश); 7. running away.

भ्रंश(स) m. 1. Falling off, dropping down, कनकवलयभ्रंशरिक्तप्रकोष्ठः Megh.i.2; 2. decay, overthrow, ruin; 3. decline, decrease; 4. disappearance; 5. loss, deprivation (as in जातिभ्रंश), स्मृतिभ्रंशाद्बुद्धिनाशः Bg.ii.63, सेहेऽस्य न भ्रंशमतो न लोभात् R.xvi.74; 6. Straying, deviation (as in शीलभ्रंश); 7. running away.
भ्रंशथु m. The same as प्रभ्रंशथु q.v.
भ्रंश(स)न n. 1. The act of dropping down; 2. of being deprived of.
भ्रंश(स)न n. 1. The act of dropping down; 2. of being deprived of.
भ्रंशिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Falling down, falling from; 2. decaying; 3. ruining.
भ्रंशिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Falling down, falling from; 2. decaying; 3. ruining.
भ्रकुंश m. An actor in female attire.
भ्रक्ष् vt. 1U (pres. भ्रक्षति-ते, भ्लक्षति-ते) To eat, to devour.
भ्रज्जन n. The act of frying or parching.
भ्रण् vt. 1P (pres. भ्रणति) To sound.
भ्रभंग m. The same as भ्रूभंग q.v.

भ्रम् vt. or vi. 1P, 4P (pp. भ्रांत; pres. भ्रमति, भ्रम्यति, भ्राम्यति) 1. To roam about, to wander about, to go about, देशे देशे विपणिषु तथा चत्वरे पानगोष्ठ्यामुन्मत्तेव भ्रमति भवतो वल्लभा हंत कीर्तिः R.G., भ्रमति गवययूथः सर्वतस्तोयमिच्छन् Rt.i.24, Bt.xii.72; (भिक्षां भ्रम् ‘to go about begging’); 2. to circulate, to turn round, to move in a circle, e.g. कुलालचक्रवन्नातस्तदा तूर्णमथाश्रमन्; 3. to totter, to waver; 4. to err, to go astray, to fall in error, to be ignorant, आभरणकारस्तु तालव्यांत इति बभ्राम S.K.; 5. to move unsteadily, to flicker, to quiver; 6. to surround; 7. to fly about humming, शोणपद्ममिवोपरि भ्रमताकुलं भ्रमरेण Git.G.iii.With उद्-, 1. to be confused, to be wild, to be mad, ध्यायत्युद्भ्रमति प्रमीलति पतत्युद्याति मूर्छत्यापे Git.G.iv.; 2. to err, to fall in error; 3. to wander about, मारीचोद्भ्रांतहारीता मलयाद्रेरुपत्यकाः R.v.46.With परि-, 1. to wander about, to rove, to ramble; 2. to hover, परिभ्रमन्मूर्धजषट्पदाकुलैः Kir.iv.14; 3. to whirl round, to revolve; 4. to describe a circle round.With वि-, 1. to wander about; 2. to hover; 3. to scatter, to frighten away; 4. to be disarranged, to be confused, to be bewildered, Bg.xvi.16.With सम्-, 1. to wander about; 2. to err, to be confused, to be perplexed.

भ्रम् Caus. (भ्रमयति-ते, भ्रामयति-ते) 1. to cause to wander, to cause to move about, भ्रमय जलदानंभोगर्भान् M.M.ix.; 2. to cause to err, to delude, to confuse, to embarass, भ्रामयन्म्सर्वभूतानि यंत्रारूढानि मायया Bg.xviii.61; 3. to wave, to brandish, लीलारविंदं भ्रमयांचकार R.vi.13.

भ्रम m. 1. Wandering about; 2. whirling, revolving; 3. erring; 4. a whirlpool, an eddy; 5. a potter’s wheel; 6. a grindstone; 7. a lathe; 8. a circular motion; 9. giddiness; 10. error, mistake, wrong notion, e.g. रज्जौ सर्पभ्रमः; 11. confusion, delusion, aberration; 12. a fountain, a watercourse.
भ्राम m. 1. Wandering about; 2. delusion, error.
भ्रम-आसक्त m. an armourer.
भ्रमण n. 1. Wandering, wandering about, roaming about; 2. turning round; 3. shaking, tottering; 4. erring; 5. giddiness.
भ्रमणी f. 1. A kind of game; 2. a leech.
भ्रमत्कुटी f. A kind of umbrella.
भ्रमर (I) m. 1. A large black bee, तिरश्चकार भ्रमराभिलीनयोः सुजातयोः पंकजकोशयोः श्रियम् R.iii.8, vii.11; 2. a gallant, a libertine; 3. a potter’s wheel.
भ्रमर (II) n. Giddiness.
भ्रामर (I) a. (f. री) Relating to a bee.
भ्रामर (II) m. A loadstone.
भ्रामर (III) n. 1. Whirling round; 2. epilepsy; 3. honey; 4. a mode of sexual enjoyment.
भ्रमर-अतिथि m. the champaka tree.
भ्रमर-अलक m. a curl on the forehead.
भ्रमर-इष्ट m. the śyoṇāka tree.
भ्रमर-उत्सवा f. the mādhavī creeper.
भ्रमर-करंडक m. a small box containing bees; (thieves carry about such a box to extinguish light in a house).
भ्रमर-कीट m. a kind of wasp.
भ्रमर-प्रिय m. a kind of kadamba tree.
भ्रमर-मंडल n. a swarm of bees.
भ्रमरक (I) m.n. 1. A lock of hair on the forehead; 2. a ball for playing with.
भ्रमरक (II) m. 1. A bee; 2. a whirlpool.
भ्रमरिका f. Wandering in all directions.
भ्रमि f. 1. Turning round, revolving; 2. a potter’s wheel; 3. a lathe; 4. a whirlwind; 5. a whirlpool; 6. an error, a mistake.
भ्रश् vi. The same as भ्रंश् q.v.
भ्राश् vi. 1Ā, 4Ā (pres. भ्राशते, भ्राश्यत; भ्लाशते, भ्लाश्यते) To shine, to glitter.
भ्रास् vi. 1Ā, 4Ā (pres. भ्रासते, भ्रास्यते; भ्लासते, भ्लास्यते) To shine, to glitter.
भ्रशिमन् m. Vehemence, violence, excessiveness.
भ्रष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Dropped down, fallen off; 2. decayed, ruined; 3. lost; 4. deprived of; 5. strayed from, (with an abl.); 6. vicious, depraved, (pp. of भ्रंश् q.v.).
भ्रष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Dropped down, fallen off; 2. decayed, ruined; 3. lost; 4. deprived of; 5. strayed from, (with an abl.); 6. vicious, depraved, (pp. of भ्रंश् q.v.).
भ्रष्ट-अधिकार a. deprived of power, fallen from office.
भ्रष्ट-गुद a. suffering from prolapsus ani.
भ्रष्ट-योग m. a backslider.

भ्रस्ज् vt. 6U (pp. भृष्ट; pres. भुज्जति-ते; caus. भ्रज्जयति-ते, भर्जयति-ते; desid. बिभर्क्षति, बिभ्रक्षति, बिभ्रज्जिषति, बिभर्जिषति) To fry, to roast, to parch, बभ्रज्ज निहते तस्मिञ् शोको रावणमग्निवत् Bt.xiv.86.
भ्राज् vi. 1Ā (pres. भ्राजते) To shine, to glitter, to flash, to beam, Bt.xiv.78, xv.24.With वि-, to shine intensely.
भ्राज (I) m. Name of one of the seven suns.
भ्राज (II) n. Name of a Sāman.
भ्राजक (I) a. (f. जिका) Making bright, illuminating.
भ्राजक (II) n. The bile.
भ्राजक (I) a. (f. जिका) Making bright, illuminating.
भ्राजथु m. Brilliance, beauty, sheen.
भ्राजिष्णु (I) a. Shining, brilliant, radiant.
भ्राजिष्णु (II) m. 1. An epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. of Śiva.
भ्रातृ (I) m. 1. A brother, M.ix.118; 2. an intimate friend; 3. a relative in general; 4. a term of friendly address, तत्वं चिंतय तदिदं भ्रातः M.Mud.3.
भ्रातृ (II) m. du. Brother and sister.
भ्रातृ-गंधि, -गंधिक a. having merely the name of a brother.
भ्रातृ-गंधि, -गंधिक a. having merely the name of a brother.
भ्रातृ-ज m. a brother’s son.
भ्रातृ-जा f. a brother’s daughter.
भ्रातुर्जाया f. a brother’s wife, a sister-in-law, द्रक्ष्यसि भ्रातृजायाम् Megh.i.10.
भ्रातुर्जाया f. a brother’s wife, a sister-in-law, द्रक्ष्यसि भ्रातृजायाम् Megh.i.10.
भ्रातृ-दत्त n. property bestowed on a girl by her brothers at the time of marriage.
भ्रातृ-द्वितीया f. a second day of the first half of Kārtīka (when sisters entertain their brothers in consequence of the Yamunā once having entertained her brother Yama on that day).
भ्रातृपुत्र m. a brother’s son.
भ्रातृपुत्र m. a brother’s son.
भ्रातृ-वधू f. a brother’s wife.
भ्रातृ-वल a. having brothers.
भ्रातृ-श्वशुर m. an elder brother of the husband.
भ्रातृ-हत्या f. fratricide.
भ्रातृक a. (f. का) Relating to a brother.
भ्रातृक a. (f. का) Relating to a brother.
भ्रातृव्य m. 1. A brother’s son, a nephew; 2. an enemy.
भ्रात्रीय m. A brother’s son, a nephew.
भ्रात्रीय m. A brother’s son, a nephew.
भ्रात्र्य n. Brotherhood.
भ्रांत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Wandered, roamed; 2. turned round, revolved; 3. mistaken, erred, perplexed; 4. moving to and fro, (pp. of भ्रम् q.v.).
भ्रांत (II) m. 1. An elephant in rut; 2. the dhattūra plant.
भ्रांत (III) n. 1. Moving about, wandering about, e.g. वरं गहनदुर्गेषु भ्रांतं वनचरैः सह; 2. error, mistake.
भ्रांत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Wandered, roamed; 2. turned round, revolved; 3. mistaken, erred, perplexed; 4. moving to and fro, (pp. of भ्रम् q.v.).

भ्रांति f. 1. Turning round, revolving, rolling, चक्रभ्राम्तिररांतरेषु जनयत्यन्यामिवारावलीम् Vikr.i.; 2. confusion, perplexity; 3. delusion, error, mistake, wrong notion (स्थाणौ पुरुषोऽयमिति ज्ञानम्); 4. doubt, uncertainty.
भ्रांति-नाशन m. an epithet of Śiva.
भ्रांति-मत् (I) a. turning round, revolving, Mal.iv.

भ्रांति-मत् (II) m. a figure of speech in rhetoric; in it, the resemblance between two things is made the basis of one of them being mistaken for the other, e.g. धूपैर्जालविनिःसृतैर्वलभयः संदिग्ध्पारावताः Vikr.iii.
भ्रांति-हर m. a minister, a counsellor.
भ्रामक m. 1. A sun-flower; 2. a jackal; 3. a deceiver, a rogue; 4. a kind of loadstone.
भ्रामर (I) a. (f. री) Relating to a bee.
भ्रामरी f. An epithet of Durgā.
भ्राष्ट्र (I) m.n. A frying-pan.
भ्राष्ट्र (II) m. Light, ether.
भ्राष्ट्रमिंध a. one who fries.
भ्राष्ट्रक m.n. A frying pan.
